name: Partnerships
intro: Partnerships with big brands that bring us customers we cannot reach alone. You do the calls and the deals; Lea and Jonas run the rest; agents do the list work around the clock.

verdict.text: The forecast reaches 1 signed partner by 31 January, 0 to 2 at the edges; the plan needs 3. Halden is the only likely deal, and nothing else has reached a qualified call yet.

goal.insight: Only Halden is likely. Two more deals need an offer by early January.

goal.calibration: No forecast can be scored yet. The first is scored on 18 December; each is kept with what happened, so the ladder learns how often Likely signs.
goal.outside: Out of this goal: Kestrel Parcel, budget frozen until spring (call on 12 November).

gap.says: To reach 3, two more deals must reach an offer in time:
steps: Brightmoor to an offer by 11 December. We assume 4 to 6 weeks from offer to signature; that is a guess until Halden signs.
Northvale or Corvane to an offer by 8 January, after this week's calls.
If neither call qualifies by Friday, send wave 2 at once. At wave 1's rates its 40 retail brands bring about 8 replies and 4 calls by mid-December.
